text:
Priya: quick note  spun a 2% canary of v6.1-quant4-longdoc this morning. Early A/B shows a concentrated rerank MRR regression on >2k tokens (~-9.8%) and p95 latency +22ms. No hallucination lift. Hypothesis: synthetic warmup missing or token-level variance from quant kernels. any quick ideas? :eyes:

Marco: dropping the early window stats here:
```
slice: longdoc_topN
baseline: v6.0-fp16 rerank_mrr=0.441
canary: v6.1-quant4 rerank_mrr=0.397
delta: -0.044 (-9.98%)
latency.p95: 170ms -> 192ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.6% -> 1.9%
logit_std_rel: +18%
```
Pattern aligns with sessions where kv_warmup_count <= 5.

Zoe: our promos currently have a small warmup job but it's only 50 samples. For longdocs that's not enough. Proposal: 1) require preflight synthetic_warmup=250 longdocs before any ramp >1%; 2) add a composite abort gate "longdoc_safety" that combines rerank_mrr z-score and logit_std ratio; 3) set hard auto-fallback if rerank_mrr_pct_drop > 5% OR latency_p95_increase > 20ms OR kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct > 1%. Snippet for rollout yaml:
```yaml
preflight:
  synthetic_warmup_samples: 250
  run_before_ramp_pct: 1
canary:
  percent: 2
auto_fallback:
  - metric: rerank_mrr_pct_drop
    threshold: 5.0
    window_sec: 600
  - metric: latency_p95_ms_abs
    threshold: 20
    window_sec: 600
  - metric: kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct
    threshold: 1.0
    window_sec: 600
composite_gates:
  - name: longdoc_safety
    formula: 0.75*rerank_mrr_z + 0.15*logit_std_z + 0.10*kv_miss_z
    abort_threshold: -1.3
```
This would have triggered here.

Priya: applying the preflight requirement and hard thresholds to the canary policy now. I'll also shrink the live canary to 0.5% until warmed shadow completes.

Marco: short-term mitigation: I'll push a routing override to set route-level kv_warmup=12 for the canary pool so caches populate ahead of scoring. Opening CL. :wrench:

Zoe: adding a small logit-variance probe to the canary dashboard (metric: logit_std_rel_pct) and a quick alert if >20% over baseline within 10m. Also adding a lightweight kernel jitter trace on a subset of canary hosts.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2150 opened: "v6.1-quant4 longdoc rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Priya: plan: 1) enforce preflight 250-sample warmup (done), 2) reduce canary to 0.5% and run warmed shadow with kv_warmup=12, 3) collect logit variance + kernel traces, 4) if auto-fallback triggers rollback automatically; otherwise iterate on quant kernel tuning and repeat preflight. Tagging @dev-sre for warmup runner. :white_check_mark:
